_comment: This file replaces /app/appsettings.json in the recommendation service container, and it
is deliberately smaller than the one in the image.
"appsettings.json") on line 9. CreateBuilder has already loaded that file; adding it a
second time appends it as the last provider, and the last provider wins. Environment
variables are registered before it, so every key this file defines is a key no
ConnectionStrings__Redis or Jwt__Key env var can override.
The fix is to keep only what is genuinely static — log levels and the feed's latency
budget — and delete every addressable setting from it. What is not here cannot shadow
anything, so the Deployment supplies Redis, the upstream URLs and the JWT stanza as
ordinary env vars, exactly like the other four services.
Deleting that AddJsonFile line in Program.cs makes this whole file unnecessary.
